technicalBlocker: The official local procedure page is not a parcel geometry API. The official Shandong map viewer is a JavaScript application with general public map services; no safe anonymous cadastral parcel-vector route was established in the bounded inspection.
remainingUncertainty: The local registry may have cadastral map data or authenticated/public-service query capabilities not exposed through the reviewed anonymous web routes. Parcel coverage at the exact WUP point and citywide completeness remain unverified.
